title: Catastrophic cancellation in log-sum-exp with extreme logits exceeding dynamic FP16 range
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0706: Catastrophic cancellation in log-sum-exp with extreme logits exceeding dynamic FP16 range
Repository: `scipy/scipy`
Category: `Numerical Stability & Tensor Geometry`
Target File: `scipy/special/_logsumexp.py`

#### Problem Description
Subtraction of max_logit causes underflow to zero in softmax denominator when logits differ by > 88.0.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Compute shift scale dynamically and use log1p formulation for high-dynamic-range stability.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0706.py -q`
expected_invariant: Compute shift scale dynamically and use log1p formulation for high-dynamic-range stability.
